answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 656 aliases needs 656 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The willow test is the live device, the umber test is the locked stake, and the lagoon test is the graded history no template can fake.
